instructions.meaning: 過去の詳細なdeployment検討から現行Task Contract設計に必要な責務、段階profile、state境界、bootstrap、distribution unitを選択・修正採用し、Requirements、設計、計画、用語集へ反映する
instructions.text: 必要部分を採用し，文書を修正

session_evidence.retained_evidence: fixed source file digest, adoption disposition, updated requirement, design, plan, glossary and index digests
session_evidence.retention_limitation: 元資料は対話形式の検討文書で出典を持たないため、提案全体を承認済み設計とは扱わず、採用・修正採用・非採用をsource recordへ固定する

adopted: logical component boundaries separated from physical process, container and host topology
local_integrated initial profile followed by evidence-gated shared_runtime and distributed_hybrid profiles
Control Plane ownership of contracts, plans, workflow state, policy, permits, decisions and provenance
Execution Plane and worker responsibility without authoritative process-local-only state
durable attempt, side-effect, capture and checkpoint recording for crash recovery
Local Execution Agent boundary for remote access to project-local files, Git and commands
stable deployment reviewing a root-isolated development candidate
separate distribution units for Runtime Core, Integration Client, Capability Adapter and Project Artifacts
adapted: middleware and review application separation into logical Control, Execution and integration responsibilities without fixing the initial process transport
Task Package and Registry into project-side Task Contract artifacts plus verified installed Capability Adapters
dynamic workflow into deterministic compilation from accepted Task Contracts and Portfolio
Docker Compose into an optional implementation decision rather than a product requirement
not_adopted: mandatory Docker, PostgreSQL, object storage, GraphRAG or Kubernetes
unchecked arbitrary executable Task Package or plugin loading
general Concierge Runtime or unrestricted task orchestration
shared server, worker pool, HPC and multi-tenant support in the initial release

scope_boundary.initial: local_integrated, single-machine and single-user with logical Control and Execution boundaries, structured I/O, durable recovery and stable/development separation
scope_boundary.later: shared_runtime after remote-security requirements and a minimal Local Execution Agent E2E
scope_boundary.deferred: distributed_hybrid only after measured worker, GPU, HPC, scheduler or scale need

verification.source_digest_check: passed: attached 692-line deployment discussion matches the recorded digest
verification.plan_source_check: passed: consolidated Plan references current Requirements, Design, Glossary and deployment source-record digests
verification.scope_self_check: passed: initial local profile is technology-neutral; shared and hybrid profiles are evidence-gated; arbitrary runtime and plugin expansion remains excluded
